Dick Whiskey is a San Francisco based independent musician. His primary instrument is the electric guitar and he writes and records what is best described as humorous rock music.

The "humorous" aspect lies in the lyrics which usually tell a humorous and/or ridiculous story. The "rock" aspect lies in the electric guitar based music which borrows from many styles, including, rock, hard rock, alternative rock, punk rock, jazz and heavy metal.
